QuestInfo.name: [Icy Onslaught - Daily] Diplomatic Victory
QuestInfo.0: Neinheart has something to tell you. Go and find out what it is.
QuestInfo.1: Neinheart says the Resistance has developed a translator device to understand the strange language spoken by the Frost King and his minions. Bring the translator with you to meet him, and find a peaceful resolution to this conflict.
QuestInfo.2: Neinheart said the Resistance has developed a translator device to understand the strange language spoken by the Frost King and his minions. You brought the translator with you to meet him, in the hopes of finding a peaceful resolution to this conflict.
